introHtml: Midweight sweaters and cardigans offer the ideal balance between warmth and comfort for indoor or mild-weather wear. Unlike bulky knits that restrict movement or lightweight options that lack insulation, midweight styles keep employees comfortable in chilly offices or outdoor events. With customizable options like embroidery or screen printing, these garments become a staple for team uniforms or promotional giveaways that recipients actually wear.
